name: Iron Skin (TEST)
note: badge.mechanism (2026-09-04): the plainest badge — two stat modifiers, folded at fielding or granted mid-battle. The mechanism's first instance.

name: The Brand (TEST)
note: badge.mechanism (2026-09-04): a badge that carries a TRIGGER and a FLAG — the second instance, pure data. Its rider sears whatever it hits; its flag is the Hero badge's (bleeds out on a failed deathbed roll) so the flag path is proved before content authors badge.hero.

name: Death's Door (TEST)
note: fix.deathbed-no-stands (2026-09-04): the Wounded badge's SHAPE — the ruled numbers (−10 Accuracy, −10 Dodge, −1 Strength, −1 Precision, −2 Max HP) and the flag that makes the next zero fatal — as a TEST row, so the rule is proved before 4-BADGES-SETTLED publishes badge.wounded. The real row is content's; this one never ships.

name: Bramble (TEST)
note: v2.thorns (2026-09-24, COMBAT-V2 section 9.4): Thorns 1 as a stat modifier - the mechanism's first instance.

name: Briar (TEST)
note: v2.thorns: Thorns 3 - the second instance, pure data.

name: Fast Hands (TEST)
note: v2.swap (2026-09-24, COMBAT-V2 section 11.2: 'Fast Hands lowers it'): swapCost -1, the mechanism's first instance. The campaign badge's value is unruled; this is TEST content only.

name: Slow Hands (TEST)
note: v2.swap (2026-09-24, COMBAT-V2 section 11.2: 'Slow Hands raises it'): swapCost +1, the second instance, pure data. TEST content only.

name: Undead Bane (TEST)
note: station.vs-target (engine, 2026-09-25): damage by what the target IS — +2 against a unit tagged undead, at DMG.VS_TARGET. The mechanism's first instance; a slayer {undead: 2} as the converter compiles it. Never ships.

name: Venom Bane (TEST)
note: station.vs-target (engine, 2026-09-25): damage by what the target CARRIES — +3 against a poisoned target, with its own poison rider so a battle reaches it. The second instance, pure data. Never ships. fix.vs-target-worn-and-flat (engine, 2026-09-25): was +50%; Andrew: 'There had been no percentage modifiers to damage' — a TEST value, flat.

name: Fender (TEST)
note: engine capability.counterattack-and-fend (2026-10-04): a badge that grants the test Fend power, so a real hero can carry it into the fielding test.fend. Test data only.

name: Burning Hands (TEST)
note: capability.unit-trigger-with-tag (2026-10-04): a badge whose trigger names a tag requirement - Burn 1 on a hit with an attack that carries the tag melee, and on no other. The ruling's own example ("you can add burn to melee attacks on a hero").

name: Burning Aim (TEST)
note: capability.unit-trigger-with-tag (2026-10-04): the same trigger with no requirement - it fires for every attack of the unit, as a unit trigger always has. The control the requirement is read against.

name: Practised Riposte (TEST)
note: engine capability.free-attack-accuracy (2026-10-04): +15 Accuracy on every special free attack the wearer makes - a counterattack, a fend, an attack of opportunity. The stat's instance, pure data (the Ledger's relic that gives Accuracy on special free attacks is not in the Codex yet). Test data only.

name: Hard to Punish (TEST)
note: engine capability.free-attack-accuracy (2026-10-04): +20 Dodge against special free attacks - the three of them, and no other attack. The stat's instance, pure data (the Ledger's '+20 Dodge versus special free attacks' is not in the Codex yet). Test data only.
